# Ali Abbas Kazmi (Ali Kazmi)

> Official personal website of Ali Abbas Kazmi, also known as Ali Kazmi.

Website: https://aliabbaskazmi.com/

Ali Abbas Kazmi is a Computer Science student at University of the People, with an expected graduation in Q4 2027. He is self-studying backend engineering and learning through personal projects. This website is his portfolio and personal space.

- [About](https://aliabbaskazmi.com/about/): Education, interests and background.
- [Projects](https://aliabbaskazmi.com/projects/): Projects he has actually published.
